driver_note: Headless EGL/GL ES verified separately; benchmark is the stock CPU software renderer.
methodology: 128 measured warm frames plus one first measured frame per workload.
Full framebuffer redraw, even where computed damage is empty.
First-frame timing is not cold process launch or cold OS cache.
No explicit allocation inside measured loops; setup and JSON output are outside the timed regions.
Damage is the clamped union bounding-box area, not exact changed-pixel count.
No upstream baseline was run; these measurements do not establish a regression or speedup.
first_frame_definition: First measured frame of this scene, not process startup or a cold OS/CPU cache.
allocation_evidence: Source inspection and Tier-0 ownership contract; no allocator instrumentation.
workload_scope: Dense/theme/sparse scenes contain box controls without text labels; complex shaping is functionally tested separately, not timed here.
